prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, mid 30s goddess, legendary bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob lavender hair — wearing a skin-tight micro boarding-school set, a cropped sleeveless V-neck vest of ultra-thin matte cream fine rib knit with navy and gold stripes along the V and the hem, a small white collar and a slim striped tie at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the rib knit fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro button-front mini skirt of ultra-thin matte forest-green rib knit with a row of small gold buttons down the center, the lowest buttons undone to open a slit up to the hip bone, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin rib knit molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the navy and gold stripes on the vest and the clean edges of the button-front skirt, a fine ribbed knit texture and fine stretch lines. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme legendary bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy cream leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in cream lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: the ancient Parthenon terrace on the Acropolis in Athens, pale weathered marble paving, fluted columns and standard-height stone steps, empty of tourists, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
